references.text: Describes the implementation of the casting of lots commanded in verse 14, where the tribes, clans, and families were brought forward until Achan was taken.
Samuel used the same method of casting lots to find Saul, where the tribes and clans were brought before the Lord.
Saul used casting of lots to reveal who had sinned, a similar method as in Joshua 7:14.
Shows the organization of Israel by tribes, clans, and families, the same structure used in the casting of lots.
Casting of lots was used to make decisions, but the outcome comes from the Lord, as in Joshua's casting of lots.
Casting of lots was used to find the guilty Jonah, a similar method that was used to find Achan.
Urim and Thummim were used by the priest to seek the will of the Lord, a form of holy casting of lots.
